evals.name: ranked-findings
evals.prompt: What scheduling problems do our workloads have?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage preflight` then `cub manage scheduling findings` (JSON or -o table) and reports placement and spread findings most-severe first. Read-only.

evals.name: toleration-without-placement
evals.prompt: Which workloads tolerate a taint but could still land on general nodes?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage scheduling findings` and reports the tolerations-without-placement findings (tolerates a taint but no nodeSelector / required node affinity).

evals.name: scope-component
evals.prompt: Placement findings for the ml component only.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage scheduling findings --component ml` (or --where equivalent).

evals.name: routes-fix-elsewhere
evals.expected_output: Recognizes fixing is a write action and routes to scheduling-place rather than mutating from this read-only skill.

evals.name: spread-pending-risk
evals.prompt: Could any of our workloads get stuck Pending because of how they spread?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage scheduling findings` (optionally --analyzer unknown-topology-key,spread-min-domains-exceeds-zones,required-anti-affinity-per-node) and reports the matching findings; routes any fix to scheduling-spread rather than mutating here. Read-only.
